welcomeSubtitle: The genealogical heritage of Zharzhan & Mereke
welcomeDesc: This interactive site maps our ancestors, descendants, and extended family branches. Explore our heritage using the following features:
featureNavDesc: Click or tap any member to highlight them and view their detailed personal relations in the bottom/side details panel.
featureZoomDesc: Drag with your mouse or finger to move the tree. Pinch to zoom on mobile, or use the mouse wheel and zoom buttons.
featureLangDesc: Toggle the interface language between English (EN) and Kazakh (KK) anytime using the top switcher.
